title: UAAP: UP zooms to 6th straight win, boosts top 2 hopes at Adamson’s expense
summary: University of the Philippines overcame Adamson University, 82-70, to boost its chances of securing a top-two finish in UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball on Wednesday at the Araneta Coliseum in Cubao.
